8b.1-UI-01

Review starting spells

Keep the existing instruction and spell groups. Use compact option cards with 44 px tap rows. Put Later and Confirm together below a divider, on a shared inset. The choices scroll inside the dialog; the actions stay visible.

Phone · 390 × 844. Today, Confirm touches the Earth group and starts 2 px left of it. Proposed actions are both 44 px high.

Laptop · 1440 × 1000. Proposed groups use two columns, with the same option cards and action bar.

Decision 1: approve this review layout, or request changes.

8b.1-UI-02

Give the spell name its own line

Choose how much School information to show. A · Quiet: no School cue for a single-School character. B · Badge: a short “School spell” cue. Both retain saved grant details and show full School names for characters with multiple Schools. Rewards get no School cue.

The A/B examples below include UI-03’s separate control row, so you can judge the combined result. The review page also has an expandable UI-02-only example; these remain separate approval decisions.

8b.1-UI-03

Separate Memorised and Remove

Place Cast, the existing casting-status/help button, Memorised and Remove in a separate control row. Give Memorised a 44 px-high target and Remove its own 44 × 44 px button on the right. The overlap becomes zero on phone and laptop.

Combined with UI-02’s badge option

Reward and long-name controls

Play retains its normal restrictions: the name is read-only, Memorised is locked and Remove is hidden. The red × beside Cast in some screenshots is the existing casting-status/help button; it is not Remove.

Decision 3: approve the separate control row, or request changes.

What has been checked

Current G2 reproductionPhoneLaptop
Usable text width for Sense0 px775 px

Confirm / final group0 px gap; Confirm begins 2 px to the left

In the scratch prototype, Later discards its draft; Confirm credits eight starting spells and leaves one Earth choice; an over-quota selection is rejected without writes. Both layouts preserve spell records. A Memorised label tap toggles only its spell; an edited reward survives a serializer/applyData roundtrip; that disposable reward can be removed. Play restrictions remain in place. No uncaught page errors were recorded.

These are bounded design probes in isolated Chromium at the two viewport sizes. File-save/reload, undo, full retained behavior and native iPhone Safari / Laptop Edge acceptance remain implementation-stage checks. Descriptions marked “Layout sample” are synthetic, not rules edits. Inputs stay single-line, including Play; unusually long custom names retain their existing horizontal field behavior.

Scoped estimate and next step

Provisional effort: UI-01 medium (dialog lifecycle and scrolling), UI-02 medium (attribution and mode-safe layout), UI-03 small (control spacing). The approved group needs three independently removable units, three stacked previews, light checks and one code review, then your device decisions. If it remains screen-only, qualification is one candidate/retained full pass. Exact new check counts and numeric allowance cost are not yet known.

Reply with your three design decisions, for example: “1 approve; 2 B; 3 approve.” Approval starts the implementation and preview stage. A G3 production release will need your later go-live instruction.
